notes: Budgets for application/runner/src/terminals/manager.ts, which only go down: scripts/ratchet/manager.test.ts fails when the file grows past one. Set from main at a1fbfdaf (2026-10-17).

slack is how far under its budget the file may sit before the budget must come down. A change that removes a little passes and the test prints the number the budget could be lowered to, so everyday product work never edits this file (about a third of main's commits touch manager.ts, and concurrent pull requests would conflict here). Past the slack, as after an extraction, the test fails until the budget is lowered, so a large win is locked in.

lines counts the file's lines. methods counts every function the Terminals class defines in its body: methods, accessors, the constructor and properties that hold a function, read from its syntax tree, so formatting never moves it.

New behaviour goes in a sibling module under application/runner/src/terminals/, as closes.ts, opens.ts and naming.ts do, with the class calling it. Work that can't is raised in the same pull request, written { "budget": n, "reason": "why", "from": "#PR or commit" }.
